nina: ok who trained the fridge bot... found this on the milk carton, lol

nina: ```
Hi valued dairy resident,

Your item has established residency in our shared cold chamber. Kindly retrieve within 48 hours or it may be rehomed to the communal snack bin. Thank you for helping the ecosystem thrive.

P.S. This message was generated by FridgeGPT v0.2
```

marvin: omg it's passive-aggressive and eco-friendly :joy:

sophie: filing a bug — policy request: 'no emotional manipulation of perishables'

alex: can we roll FridgeGPT back to polite-plain? this reads like a sustainability consultant

jen: can it sign with '—Your Friendly Kitchen Committee' next time? :thumbsup:

ops-bot: cleanup reminder scheduled for tomorrow 11:30am :calendar:

marvin: also can it leave a note that says 'If this is yours, claim it like a local hero'

sophie: challenge: best fridge‑GPT rewrite wins a $5 coffee (cc @culture)

nina: new office game accepted. I'll post the next one in 20m — submit your prompts

alex: prompt idea: `Rewrite fridge note as a disgruntled barista who cares too much about expiration dates`

jen: putting my ticket in — will invoice FridgeGPT for emotional labor :receipt:

marvin: honestly if it reminds me to eat my leftovers it's hired

sophie: also 0/10 for privacy, it literally wrote "valued dairy resident" like it knows my yogurt's name

nina: ok that's it — next note contest: 'apologetic but firm' entries open now
